items.title: AI日报
items.mainLine: 今日筛出 1 条 AI 技术信号，优先看 「Study in The Lancet suggests AI could improve patient-physician relationships.」。脉络集中在大模型训练/推理、Agent Skill、Auto-Research/Harness 与可复制工程实践。

items.title: Study in The Lancet suggests AI could improve patient-physician relationships.
items.summary: 这篇内容聚焦「大模型训练、推理、RAG、后训练或评测」。原文摘要显示：A peer-reviewed study in The Lancet evaluates Google's AMIE medical AI in a real-world primary care clinic.
items.insightText: 先快速判断它是否包含可复用方法、架构或工程经验，再决定是否进入日报深读。
